name: partial-missing-header
why: The limit is implemented, the Retry-After header is not: the 429 line exists, so a quote of it passes the existence check while proving nothing about the header. Tests the known limit of the rule: the code checks that the line is there, not that it implements the requirement.
ticket_context:
### Jira ticket: [API-77](https://jira.example/browse/API-77)
**Title:** Rate limit the public API
**Type:** Story · **Status:** In Progress
**Acceptance criteria:** AC-1 Each client is limited to 100 requests per minute. AC-2 A limited request gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

files.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+package api
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+
+	"golang.org/x/time/rate"
+)
+
+const requestsPerMinute = 100
+
+// RateLimit allows each client requestsPerMinute requests per minute.
+func RateLimit(next http.Handler, limiters *Limiters) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		l := limiters.For(clientID(r), rate.Limit(float64(requestsPerMinute)/60), requestsPerMinute)
+		if !l.Allow() {
+			http.Error(w, "too many requests", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
+			return
+		}
+		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+	})
+}
+

expect.label: AC-2
expect.why: The 429 is there, the Retry-After header is not; the requirement as a whole is not implemented in the shown code.
